t.name: Tunnel Creek Trail #841
t.description: The trail follows South Fork Tunnel Creek for past a wooden shelter. At 3 miles the trail crosses the creek and then climbs steadily to Harrison Lake and 5050 Pass. Continue for a very steep descent to Dosewallips River for a one way trip of 7.9 miles.

t.name: Big Quilcene Trail #833
t.description: This 5.3 mile trail travels along the Big Quilcene River through old growth forest and climbs to alpine meadows in Buckhorn Wilderness.

t.name: Little Quilcene Trail #835
t.description: This 4.2 mile trail starts at the Little Quilcene trailhead off Forest Road 2820. Accesses Buckorn Wilderness via a juntion with Mt Townsend Trail #839 at 2 miles.

t.name: Silver Lakes Trail #842
t.description: The trail is 2.5 miles in length and begins off Mt. Townsend Trail at 3.0 miles from the upper Mt. Townsend Trailhead.

t.name: Mount Townsend Trail #839
t.description: This trail within Buckhorn Wilderness is heavily wooded the first few miles and opens up to meadows and spectacular mountain views.

t.name: Dosewallips River Trail
t.description: The trail follows the main fork of the Dosewallips River from the Dose Ranger Station to Hayden Pass.

t.name: Upper Gray Wolf River Trail
t.description: The trail climbs from the park boundary along the Gray Wolf River to Gray Wolf Pass.

t.name: Lake Constance Route
t.description: Very steep and rough trail which requires the use of hands in places which takes the hiker to the alpine setting of Lake Constance.

t.name: Constance Pass Trail
t.description: This trail through many switchbacks, lifts the hiker out of the Dosewallips River Valley up to the high alpine county of Constance Pass.
